## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. It starts at Burj Khalifa, 1 Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid Blvd - Downtown Dubai.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Explore the world’s highest lounge at 585 meters above the ground and immerse yourself in the clouds with an exclusive tour of the Burj Khalifa's outdoor terrace. Delight in an impeccable selection of the finest teas and coffees or enjoy a house beverage or glass of bubbly complemented by gourmet canapes.
>
> Towering over Dubai's hypermodern skyline at 828 meters, the Burj Khalifa is the world's most instantly recognizable skyscraper. We'd say it's a must-see – but then again, it's kind of hard to miss! Take your trip to new heights with this ticket. Nibble on delicate canapes and sip champagne, and don't forget to clink glasses on the impressive outside terrace, as the sun sparkles across the Gulf coast and endless desert, hundreds of feet below!
>
> The best time to visit the The Lounge at Burj Khalifa? For the clearest views, get your head in the clouds in the afternoon. For the ultimate ambiance, enjoy a starlit evening experience – this ticket lets you choose!

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €213.75. It was rated 4.6 out of 5 from 101 ratings and 56 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
